newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian pound falls fractionally vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian pound falls fractionally vs dollar.

text.p: The Egyptian pound fell marginally against the dollar in the private-sector market on Thursday despite an increase in the supply of the U.S. currency, bankers said.
"Most banks were squared with the approach of year-end and week-end," one banker said. The financial year ends on June 30.
Private-sector bankers said the dollar ranged from 3.3950 to 3.3980 pounds bid and from 3.3975 to 3.3985 pounds offered in the interbank market.
A survey of six actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.3968 pounds bid and 3.3981 offered. These averages compared to 3.3956 pounds bid and 3.3980 offered on Wednesday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at the opening as 3.394464 buy and 3.397910 sell.
